name: ArcChain / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. Three clearly separated electrical relays skipping through conductive water, with strong irregular zaps, sizzling water, trailing wet crackles and a falling spark tail. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
